parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud partner (certified ISV) account or individual user account.

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the network interface controller (NIC).

parameters.name: Permission
parameters.description:
The network interface controller (NIC) permission action. Only InstanceAttach is supported.

InstanceAttach: allows the authorized user to attach your NIC to their ECS instance. The ECS instance must be in the same zone as the NIC.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region of the network interface controller (NIC) permission. You can invoke [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
